<!-- Write in English. See docs/review-guidelines.md for review expectations. -->

## Summary

Describe what changed.

## Outcome

Describe what changes as a result, including before/after behavior when useful.

## Validation

Describe pre-merge checks and their actual results, including any unperformed or
blocked checks. Separately list genuinely required post-merge checks as pending,
or state that none are needed. After merge and Issue closure, record evidence and
track actual defects in a new linked Issue (or existing equivalent), following the
[post-merge workflow](https://github.com/takahirox/three-game-kit/blob/main/docs/development-flow.md#6-perform-post-merge-verification).

## Related issues

Link relevant issues. Use and preserve closing keywords (for example,
`Closes #123`) when the implementation fully addresses the Issue and mandatory
pre-merge acceptance is satisfied. Pending post-merge-only verification does not
make the implementation partial or require keeping the Issue open. For intentional
partial work, state what remains, avoid closing keywords for the parent Issue,
and keep it open.
